answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 160821 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Is Mussels halal to eat in Ahnaf mazhab, if not why? Question: Is Mussels halal to eat in Ahnaf mazhab, if not why? Answer ID: 160821 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/817/M=8/1439) By ‘mussels’ if you mean the shell insect which is known as ghongha in Hindi then it is not halal to eat it according to Hanafi Fiqh as only fish is halal among the sea animals, whereas the seashell is an insect. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
